name: laundry-crm-mern
description: Full-stack MERN CRM for laundry and dry-cleaning businesses.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently "npm run db:local" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
